summary.note: 2026-09-08: fc-2026-09-07-znpp graded CORRECT (external power restored 7 Sep, well ahead of fuel exhaustion). Three new PENDING forecasts added this cycle tracking the Hormuz exclusion zone, the MikroTik KEV-listing question, and the DoD-Anthropic removal timeline.

forecasts.forecast: The CMMC 60-day review will conclude with a reformed-but-intact program and a reset phased timeline (not a repeal).
forecasts.note: Tracked on the CMMC Implementation thread; DoW CIO internal determination now roughly five days away (~13 Sep).

forecasts.forecast: Golden Dome award tempo will accelerate through late 2026 into early 2027.
forecasts.note: No new award data this cycle; pre-year-end SBI test remains the key milestone to watch.

forecasts.forecast: The Kyiv-Moscow long-range-strike pause will lapse at term absent a broader framework.
forecasts.note: Rather than a simple lapse, a 7 Sep Trump-Putin call produced a different, narrower, category-bounded 30-day energy-infrastructure strike-halt commitment (contingent on Ukrainian reciprocity) - neither a clean lapse nor a comprehensive framework.

forecasts.forecast: China will not materially relax rare-earth/magnet controls on military-affiliated firms in the near term.
forecasts.note: Confirmed and extended: June 2026 entity-list action specifically targets MP Materials and USA Rare Earth, showing continued tightening rather than relaxation.

forecasts.forecast: Iran will follow through on its threatened 'faster, heavier, more painful' response with at least one further strike on a U.S.-linked or U.S.-flagged vessel or asset within 30 days.
forecasts.note: No confirmed further strike as of 8 Sep; Iran instead announced intent to declare a Hormuz exclusion zone, a policy instrument rather than a strike. Tracked on the U.S.-Iran Conflict / Strait of Hormuz thread.

forecasts.forecast: The reported 30-day Ukraine energy-infrastructure strike-halt commitment will not hold cleanly for its full term without at least one contested violation claim from either side.
forecasts.note: Only into its first full day as of 8 Sep; no reciprocity confirmation or violation yet. Tracked on the Ukraine Ceasefire Diplomacy / Zaporizhzhia thread.

forecasts.forecast: External power will be restored to the Zaporizhzhia plant (or sufficient diesel resupply will occur) before onsite fuel is exhausted, avoiding a station blackout.
forecasts.note: External power was restored 7 Sep 19:02 local via the repaired Ferrosplavna-1 line, well within the fuel window; the IAEA-brokered local ceasefire held long enough to complete the repair.

forecasts.forecast: The DoW CIO's internal CMMC Reform Task Force determination (~13 Sep) will recommend resuming assessment scaling on a revised timeline rather than a further indefinite pause or repeal.
forecasts.note: Determination window now roughly five days out; no new substance to update the assessment.

forecasts.forecast: Iran will formally publish and attempt to enforce the Hormuz-adjacent 'exclusion zone,' but will not succeed in materially reducing U.S.-escorted commercial transit volumes within 30 days.
forecasts.note: Tracked on the U.S.-Iran Conflict / Strait of Hormuz thread; boundaries/enforcement not yet published as of 8 Sep.

forecasts.forecast: CISA will add the MikroTik RouterOS 'MikroTrick' CVEs (2026-67276 / 2026-86060) to the KEV catalog within 30 days given confirmed active exploitation.
forecasts.note: Tracked on the Actively Exploited Edge / AI-Infra / E-commerce CVEs thread.

forecasts.forecast: DoD will proceed with removing Anthropic's models from GenAI.mil by late September as stated, absent a D.C. Circuit stay or injunction.
forecasts.note: Tracked on the DoD AI Vendor Governance / Anthropic Dispute thread.
